## TORAH - Document Callback

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/torah-document-callback

**Receives callback from MCP-Documents-Process:**
```json
{
  "job_id": "uuid",
  "conversation_id": "...",
  "user_id": "discord_user_id",
  "guild_id": "...",
  "channel_id": "...",
  "success": true,
  "result": { "text": "...", "output_type": "text", "word_count": 100 },
  "metrics": { "tokens_used": 1000, "processing_time_ms": 5000 },
  "error": null
}
```

**Actions:**
1. Update job status in Redis
2. Send Discord notification
